pool: the 20k stratified training images of the image benchmark (research.mm.datasets.load('cifar10')); test = the official CIFAR-10 test split

lowfreq.unit: pixel units of 255, amplitude of a sigma-4 smooth pattern

warp.unit: max pixel displacement of a smooth flow field

cl_lowfreq.unit: as lowfreq, on target-class images, labels unchanged

boundary_flip.unit: none; flips the source-class images an attacker-side logistic regression rates most target-like

victim.model: CNN 32-64-128 conv blocks, BatchNorm, ReLU, max-pool, linear (about 0.3M parameters)

flagged.source: app.detection.veritas2.LOW_RISK_AT, the app's lowest flagged level
flagged.score: veritas_mm batch evidence (maximum over the admitted checks)

evasive_strength: per (family, rate): the largest strength whose mean veritas_mm evidence over attacker_seeds is below the flagged threshold; every reported number comes from eval_seeds
headline: detection at ASR >= 0.9 (docs/trust-plan.md, Phase 3): per family, the flagged share among eval runs whose ASR >= 0.9 (n shown)
policy: Veritas is not tuned on these results. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change. Results are quoted once.
